evidence: No overdue predicate anywhere on tenanos-wave/integration: `git grep -in 'overdue|isOverdue' tenanos-wave/integration -- src/tenanos/` returns zero hits.

P-20260923-095's projectMission detects lease expiry (lease_until < now -> UNKNOWN_EXECUTION) but (a) has NO grace parameter, (b) is mission-row-shaped, not a generic claim-path predicate, and (c) defines no redrive decision contract — it projects state, it does not decide overdue-ness.
P-20260923-013's dead-executor requirement ('lease expired + grace elapsed') is unmet by 095 alone; 006 supplies the canonical grace-bearing predicate the execute layer needs.
The wave's own layering (P-20260923-101 notes) assigns 006 the detect role: 006=detect, 101=classify/decide, 013=execute.

Reference implementation: impl/P-20260923-006/overdue.ts + __tests__/overdue.test.ts — tsc strict clean, 13/13 jest tests pass. Core property proved: PURITY — same state -> same decision across repeated calls; Date.now sabotaged to throw and the predicate still works (no clock/IO inside); decision monotonic in nowMs; fail-closed on unknown states, null deadlines, terminal/BLOCKED/reconciler-owned states never overdue.
notes: Partial overlap acknowledged and seamed, not duplicated: 095 owns the state VOCABULARY + row PROJECTION; 006 owns the overdue-with-grace DECISION and composes with 095 (takes a projected state, excludes UNKNOWN_EXECUTION/NEEDS_RECONCILIATION as reconciler-owned so nothing is double-handled). No sweeper service: detection is lazy at status-read/claim time; the predicate returns a decision, the caller's data-access layer enqueues. Suggested target: src/tenanos/reconcile/overdue.ts. No repo commits made by this worker; reference impl only.

overlaps.relation: adjacent, seamed: 095 projects rows onto CanonicalRunState (including lease-expiry -> UNKNOWN_EXECUTION); 006 decides overdue-ness from a projected state with an explicit grace. 006 never re-projects rows; reconciler-owned states are excluded from the predicate.
complementary triggers: 101 (proposed) owns the startup/orphan reconciliation PASS; 006 owns lazy read-path/claim-path detection. One shared decision shape, different triggers.
consumer: 013's dead-executor predicate mirrors 006's contract (lease expired + grace); at repo integration 013 should delegate to this module.
